content: We have applied template 1914385 to target molecule and got precursors: ('C=CC=C', 'COC(=O)C1=CC(=O)C1'). So the retrosynthetic step splits the ester into a diene (C=CC=C) and a cyclic anhydride? Actually second is COC(=O)C1=CC(=O)C1 which is methyl 1,4-benzoquinone? Wait SMILES: COC(=O)C1=CC(=O)C1 is methyl 2,5-dihydroxy? Let's interpret: COC(=O)C1=CC(=O)C1 is methyl 1,4-benzoquinone? Actually methyl 1,4-benzoquinone is COC(=O)C1=CC(=O)C1. Yes that's methyl benzoquinone (para). So the precursors are 1,3-butadiene (C=CC=C) and methyl benzoquinone (COC(=O)C1=CC(=O)C1).
